overview: Cosmology papers apply normalizing flows and simulation-based inference to DESI DR1 and DES Y3, while neural operators, PINNs and macrocanonical generators emulate MHD, stellar and cosmological fields. LLM agents address simulation calibration, observing strategy and research pipelines. New benchmarks include COSMIO cross-survey imputation and small-data image classifiers; survey catalogues span Fermi-LAT, EMU, SUMSS and a 10.13-million-star homogenised catalogue.
themes: Benchmarks for cross-survey and small-data ML
